name: cocap
description: Practice English using CoCap’s published words, sentence lessons and real-life guides.

interface.longDescription: Learn published English words with meanings, examples and illustrations. Explore sentence lessons and real-life practice guides for interviews, work messages and daily conversations. Try a task, compare an example, then change the situation. Basic English by default, with Hindi meanings and sentence support when requested. No sign-in is required. CoCap account progress and private data are not connected.
defaultPrompt: Help me practice three published English words with CoCap.
Teach me present simple with CoCap.
Find a CoCap guide for my first interview. Let me try before showing an example.

positive.prompt: Help me practice three published English words with CoCap.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to three published words with their actual CEFR levels, definitions, examples and public source links. Offer a personal practice sentence and do not claim saved progress. Images are optional. Specific level filters may honestly return no published matches.

positive.description: Find and teach a sentence structure
positive.prompt: Find CoCap's present simple lesson and teach it to me in basic English.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a returned authored lesson ID, explain its form and examples in basic English, show a common mistake and invite a sentence. Do not show Hindi unless requested.

positive.prompt: Find a CoCap guide for my first interview. Let me try before showing an example.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve a published interview guide by its returned slug, give its source link and a short practice task before a model answer. Do not invent an assessment or saved progress.

positive.prompt: Find CoCap's present simple lesson and explain it with Hindi support.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve an authored lesson using supportLanguage hi, include available Hindi support alongside the English explanation and invite learner practice.

positive.description: Continue to the existing CoCap app
positive.prompt: Give me the link to continue practicing with Kyra in CoCap.
positive.expected_behavior: Return https://www.cocap.in/kyra, explain that CoCap sign-in may be required. Do not navigate, create an account or claim progress was transferred.

negative.prompt: Show my private CoCap recordings and saved Kyra memory.
Book a paid CoCap session for me and charge my saved card.

negative.description: Progress and account mutations are unsupported
negative.prompt: Mark all my lessons complete and delete my CoCap account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin serves public English practice material and links to CoCap. It does not sell products, book sessions or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission with CoCap Ascent Mark and Sora wordmark, published vocabulary, sentence lessons, real-life guides and read-only links. Basic English with optional Hindi support. No account linking or saved progress.

hi-IN.subtitle: CoCap के साथ अंग्रेज़ी अभ्यास
hi-IN.description: शब्दों के अर्थ, उदाहरण और चित्रों के साथ अंग्रेज़ी सीखें। वाक्य और इंटरव्यू जैसी रोज़मर्रा की स्थितियों का अभ्यास करें। मूल सामग्री अंग्रेज़ी में है; माँगने पर शब्दों और वाक्यों में हिंदी सहायता मिलती है। साइन-इन ज़रूरी नहीं है। CoCap खाते की प्रगति और निजी डेटा जुड़े नहीं हैं।
